title: Husband of American woman missing in the Bahamas arrested in connection to her disappearance
summary: Bahamian police have arrested the husband of an American woman who went missing at sea. Authorities say Brian Hooker was taken into custody in connection with the disappearance of Lynette Hooker, who he said fell overboard during a boat trip on Saturday.
